name: Photo and finish
purpose: Choose optional face/photo styling, capture a thumbnail and save exactly once.
on_enter: Draft context must be revealed for current revision; otherwise return to last incomplete creation step.
Saved context is view-only by default; new face choices require explicit Remix.
This scene owns the previously unspecified eight-face selector. Faces are optional; start with none, not a forced face.
on_exit: Checkpoint photo choices and a valid thumbnail reference; a failed save keeps draft and all UI state.
persistence: draft photoOptions={backgroundId,frameId,rotation}; faceId belongs only to recipe. Capture stores capturedRecipeRevision and capturedPhotoRevision. Saving commits immutable recipe, thumbnail, shelf slot, completion ledger and discoverable grants in one logical transaction.
back_rule: Back 09 with same context. After successful save use delivery return flow if request active, else show queued 13 overlays then 11.
acceptance: Double-tap Save creates one toy and at most one completion grant.
Changing face/background/rotation/frame invalidates old capture before Save.
Storage failure never shows Saved or grants uncommitted coins.
implementation_notes: Capture uses the renderer, not device camera or screenshot of UI. No photo permission requested.
In saved view-only context capture can preview locally but cannot earn/save a duplicate; Remix is explicit.

actions.command: Open bounded choice drawer with cream/mint/lilac; confirmed selection changes preview
actions.feedback: New photo backdrop, toy recipe unchanged.
actions.interrupt: Close without selection preserves prior value.

actions.command: Choose none/cream/lilac/star; frame is photo decoration, not gel material
actions.feedback: Frame visible only in photo output, not live toy.

actions.guard: Editable draft or explicit remix accepted
actions.command: Choose none or one of eight IDs: smile, sleepy, surprise, wink, cheer, curious, blush, neutral
actions.state_write: recipe.faceId changes; recipeRevision++; bump photoRevision; do not invalidate already-filled physical body for a face-only decal. Do not change filledBodyRevision or revealedBodyRevision for a face-only change.
actions.feedback: Face follows surface UV; chosen outline.
actions.interrupt: Saved original never changes. See bodyRevision/recipeRevision separation in data contract.

actions.command: Rotate within ±30 degree yaw / ±15 pitch from approved view, or tap step controls
actions.feedback: No squish gesture in photo mode.
actions.interrupt: Cancel retains bounded angle, no reset.

actions.feedback: 250ms rotation, no blur in quiet mode.
250ms rotation, no blur in quiet mode.

actions.guard: Renderable valid recipe/photo state; not saving
actions.command: Wait next stable render frame, capture 384px long-edge thumbnail, store capture revisions
actions.state_write: Thumbnail temporary record keyed by draft/capture ID.
actions.feedback: Gentle shutter + check, no full-screen white flash.
actions.interrupt: Cancel/error leaves previous valid capture only if revisions still match.

actions.guard: Editable draft, valid captured recipe/photo revisions, transaction not in flight
actions.command: saveCreation(draftId,stableCreationId) atomic service; allocate next free shelf slot; evaluate grants; retain active request association
actions.state_write: Immutable recipe and thumbnail + shelf + reward ledger + metrics + pending discovery queue + draft.savedCreationId. Acknowledge only after commit.
actions.feedback: Saved check then one short shelf placement, no speculative coin count.
actions.destination: 12 deliverable request context, otherwise pending 13 queue returning 11, then 11
actions.interrupt: On transaction abort restore Save with Retry; same IDs used on retry; no partial wallet or missing thumbnail.
